description: This file defines classes for handling reboot commands in a kickstart configuration, including different versions for various Fedora releases. It includes methods for parsing commands, generating command strings, and handling command-line options.

classes.name: FC3_Reboot
classes.description: Handles reboot commands for Fedora Core 3, including parsing and string representation.

classes.name: FC6_Reboot
classes.description: Extends FC3_Reboot with additional eject option for Fedora Core 6.

classes.name: F18_Reboot
classes.description: Extends FC6_Reboot with support for halt command in Fedora 18.

classes.name: F23_Reboot
classes.description: Extends F18_Reboot with support for kexec option in Fedora 23.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for each class, initializing specific options and attributes.

methods.name: _getArgsAsStr
methods.description: Generates string representation of command-line arguments.

methods.name: __str__
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the command, including comments and command keywords.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to set internal state.

methods.name: _getParser
methods.description: Creates and returns an option parser for the command.

methods.name: set_to_self
methods.description: Sets object attributes based on parsed namespace (used in FC6_Reboot.parse).
